question: What are the inner diameter and height of the stainless-steel tube of the bubbling fluidized bed apparatus used for ammonia co-firing?
rendered:
document title="Carbon-Free Ammonia Co-firing in Fluidized Bed Combustion: Analysis of Advanced Chemical Modeling and Detailed Mechanism"

=== page 3 ===
- apparatus consists of an electrically heated BFB constructed from a stainless steel (SUS) 304 tube, a coal feeder, a gas supply system, and a gas sampling and analysis system.
- The inner diameter and height of the SUS tube are 50 and 1250 mm, respectively.
